hero.lead: I build APIs, financial integrations and AI agents for credit and collections fintechs — from the service that talks to the bank to the screen where customers settle their debts.

jornada.sub: A short but intense path: almost everything I know I learned solving real problems in production.

itens.texto: Java with JFrame, Git and GitHub, a JavaScript course and my first published website.
I join Salt to build collection tools for fintechs. First big project: the company's new website.
Alura's React track, my first portfolio and Astro portals for clients across different industries.
Node.js and Express in production: settlement APIs and integrations with banks, payment providers and SOAP services.
Agents on the Claude API and MCP orchestrating collection routines, and a multi-tenant white-label portal with i18n and E2E tests.
Wrapping up a B.Sc. in Software Engineering, alongside work.

inspiracoes.sub: People from very different fields with one thing in common: when I watch their work, I understand where I want to get one day.

ana.papel: My mom · Physical Education and Law
ana.texto: She pushes me to my limits and helps me go beyond them. I certainly wouldn't be who I am without her.

kerber.texto: Founded the company where I grew as a developer and shows, in practice, how to turn technology into a business.

akita.texto: Decades of career, unfiltered opinions and a lot of learning in public. The visual reference for this site came from him.

igor.texto: Started with a gaming channel and built one of the biggest podcasts in Brazil.

rato.texto: Years of making content about games, electronics and robotics his own way, without losing authenticity.

acf.texto: Turned the daily life of a tuning shop into one of Brazil's biggest car channels, with consistency video after video.

cev.texto: Where I wrote my first lines of JavaScript. Quality teaching, for free, for anyone who wants to start.

mat.texto: Rebuilds wrecked cars learning as he goes, without being a trained mechanic. Hard work beats talent.

destaque.texto: Programming and car mechanics are two big passions of mine, and they have a lot in common. Both call for investigation, hypotheses, conclusions and, above all, getting your hands dirty. Whether it is a bug in production or a strange noise in the engine, the path is the same: understand the cause before doing anything.

jogos.texto: I enjoy competitive shooters like Counter-Strike, Brawlhalla with friends, stealth games like Hitman and Splinter Cell, co-op like PEAK and the classic Garry's Mod sandbox, which has been with me for years.

simuladores.texto: Assetto Corsa and BeamNG.drive, plus some Euro Truck Simulator now and then: where my love for cars and technology meet.

impressao.texto: Model, slice, tweak and print again: a trial-and-error loop that feels a lot like debugging.

bastidores.sub: Fun facts about how this site was built, the repository in numbers and where it is headed.
bastidores.numerosNota: Computed automatically on the last build.
bastidores.hojeTexto: There is no backend or database behind this site, for now. Every text, project and technology lives in JSON and JS files inside the repository, and every change is a commit that Vercel publishes on its own.

hardcoded.texto: All content lives in src/i18n and src/dados. Simple, versioned and fast, but every update needs a deploy.

ia.texto: Claude helped along the way, speeding up repetitive tasks and acting as a partner to bounce ideas off. The decisions and the care are mine.

padrao.titulo: Same conventions as my day job
padrao.texto: Follows the same conventions I use day to day: role-based CSS tokens, styled-components and a styles.jsx next to each component.

gato.texto: The "Off the clock" illustration came from the 2024 portfolio. It was deleted during cleanup and rescued from git history.

curriculo.texto: The Portuguese and English PDFs, the favicon and the share image are generated by scripts that render HTML in the browser.

crawlers.titulo: Built to be found by AI
crawlers.texto: It ships an llms.txt, JSON-LD structured data and a robots.txt that welcomes AI crawlers by name.

cores.texto: The whole palette is defined in OKLCH, with text contrast above 7:1 in both themes.

historia.texto: The first version, from January 2024, used Create React App and plain CSS. This is the full rewrite, from October 2026.
